task.ques: Show most played games in Steam. And tell me the number of players in In game at this time

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Counter-Strike 2 is Steam’s most-played game right now, with 575,675 players in game.

Steam’s top five by current players, checked October 27, 2026:
1. Counter-Strike 2 — 575,675
2. Dota 2 — 522,083
3. Deadlock — 207,472
4. AION 2 — 179,829
5. FiveM — 159,005

Source: Steam Charts, “Most Played Right Now”: https://store.steampowered.com/charts/
The “By Current Players” ranking is also shown at https://store.steampowered.com/charts/mostplayed.
Evidence: final.png shows the five games and their live counts together, including Counter-Strike 2’s “IN GAME” label.
